description.mn: Acqua di Parma Osmanthus: Хүйс харгалзахгүй цэцэгсийн үнэр (EDP). Эхний ноот: нероли, мандарин; зүрхний ноот: амбретт, цээнэ цэцэг, ягаан чинжүү; суурь ноот: османтус, пачули.
description.en: Osmanthus Eau de Parfum by Acqua di Parma is a Floral fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Osmanthus Eau de Parfum was launched in 2019. Top notes are Neroli and Green Mandarin; middle notes are Ambrette (Musk Mallow), Peony and Pink Pepper; base notes are Osmanthus and Patchouli.
